protocol.purpose: Full-equation differentiable optimization smoke, not a neural task benchmark or a parameter-identifiability claim
protocol.target: 80-digit literal Eq8/9/12/A5/A7 evaluated at the three fixed assets
protocol.loss: mean squared scaled error over all five full-kernel outputs and all fixed asset states
protocol.optimizer: Adam proposal with alpha=.08, betas=.9/.999, epsilon=1e-8 and at most 12 explicit step halvings; reject invalid or increasing-loss candidates
protocol.qualifier: The actual task controller elsewhere uses a finite CTMC; this full-HX mini optimization does not certify that controller as full-HX BPTT. Cast gradients follow numerical AD conventions, not derivatives of rounding.
